info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to decay, to get killed, to get destroyed, to wane, to go away, to reduce, to shrink

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: nazwa honA, sUkzma honA, hrAsa honA, kama honA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ( antarBAvitaRyarTastu sakarmakaH ) ' kzaye kzayati, hiMsAyAM kziRAtIti zito Bavet . nivAsagatyoH kziyati, kziRotyAvaguRe kziRoH' (Slo.12.13) iti devaH .  " O - uvikaraRe aguRe guRABAve ca sati ' kzaRu hiMsAyAM kzaRu ca ' iti mEtreyarakzitAdyuktasya DAtoH kziRotIti Bavati " iti puruzakAre lIlASukamuniH . antarBAvitaRyarTopi ayam - ' na kzIyate iti akzaram ' iti BAzye darSanAt . taTA sati sakarmakatvamapi .

info.name: karmakatvam
info.note: asya DAtoH antarBAvitaRyarTe (= Ric-pratyayasya arTe parantu Ric-pratyayaM vinA, yaTA 'kzayaM karoti/nASayati' ityasmin arTe) sakarmakatvaM dfSyate .

examples: loke prAyeRAkarmako'yam. vede tu sakarmako dfzwaH. sakarmakatve divAdirna.
'upalaprakziRI nanA' (f॰9.112.3). upalena pezaRakarItyarTaH.  prakzIRamidaM devadattasya. iha devadattaScikzAya. ayaM devadattakzayasya pradeSa ityarTaH.
'paSUntsaNkziRAti' (aTarva॰3.28.2). ezA vijAtA yaminI paSUnAM hAnaye kalpata ityAha.
'nU no rAsva… dyumadagne suvIryaM varzizWamanupakzitam' (f0 3.13.7). anupakzitaM vyaye kriyamARe'pyanupakzIRam. akzayyamityarTaH.
